_readme: Norm values the rule engine uses. 'verified' = checked against a public AICTE source (see source); 'to_verify' = placeholder until the team copies the exact value from the official APH 2024-27 PDF. Admins can edit these in the Admin page; every rule evaluation records the edition used.

norms.note: At or below 50% average admissions, faculty requirement is reduced by 25%.
